title: An upset customer with two problems is calmed first, then handed over

turns.user: mujhe kal colour karwaya tha, rang bilkul different hai aur main 30 minute late thi to unhone jaldi khatam kar diya

model.text: Sorry, ye theek nahi hua. Main ye baat owner tak pahuncha raha hoon — wohi aap ke colour ke liye next step batayenge. Aap kis din aa sakti hain?
Main free ya paid ka wada nahi kar sakta — ye owner ka faisla hai. Unhone aap ko yahan reply karna hai, main unhe abhi bata raha hoon.
